methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Return true if there are no row groups

methods.summary: Create a new `RowGroupPlanBuilder` for pruning out the groups to scan based on metadata and statistics

methods.name: prune_by_limit
methods.signature: fn prune_by_limit(&mut self, limit: usize, rg_metadata: &[RowGroupMetaData], metrics: &ParquetFileMetrics)

methods.name: prune_by_range
methods.summary: Prune remaining row groups to only those  within the specified range.

methods.name: prune_by_statistics
methods.signature: fn prune_by_statistics(&mut self, arrow_schema: &Schema, parquet_schema: &SchemaDescriptor, groups: &[RowGroupMetaData], predicate: &PruningPredicate, metrics: &ParquetFileMetrics)

methods.summary: Return the number of row groups that are currently expected to be scanned
